_comment: Run 'python -m blackboard_mcp --login' once before first use, and again
whenever the cached session expires. Tools fail fast with that hint rather
than hanging the client while a browser waits for an Okta push.
BB_DOWNLOAD_ROOT is optional; it defaults to ~/Downloads/blackboard, and is
the only way to put downloads outside your home directory. To change the
folder from chat instead, use the set_download_root tool.
All file writes are confined to that directory.
